content.question: How does the agent select actions in Q-Learning, and how are Q-coefficients updated?
options: Actions are always chosen greedily by the highest Q-value, and the Q-coefficients are never updated during training.
Actions are chosen by balancing exploration and exploitation, and Q-coefficients of the taken pair follow the Bellman update.
Actions are chosen uniformly at random at every step, and Q-coefficients are averaged over all visited state-action pairs.
Actions are chosen by always repeating the highest-reward action seen so far, and Q-coefficients come from a covariance matrix.
content.answer: Actions are chosen by balancing exploration and exploitation, and Q-coefficients of the taken pair follow the Bellman update.
